title: Check: Arc Length and Sector Area

questions.stem: A sector has an area of $12\pi\text{ cm}^2$ and a radius of $6\text{ cm}$. What is the angle of the sector?
questions.explanation: $A = \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2$, so $12\pi = \frac{\theta}{360} \times 36\pi$. Dividing both sides by $\pi$: $12 = \frac{36\theta}{360}$, so $\theta = \frac{12 \times 360}{36} = 120°$.
